heading: What `dynamic_ttl` does not affect
text:
## What `dynamic_ttl` does not affect [LDTL.9]

- All non-TTL schema lifecycles (`logical`, `explicit`, `activation`,
  `ambient`) — unaffected.
- TTL schemas that use only the schema-level TTL duration — no behaviour
  change; their assert/retract cost is the same either way.
- Series TTL (sliding window duration) — independent of this extension.
- Cooldown timing — independent; it compares readings of the monotonic
  clock ([LTIM.2.8.2]), not WM expiry.
- The `retain:` kwarg on `cache` actions — `cache` is not WM; this
  extension does not affect cache TTL semantics.
